summary: In vyos.vyos, VyOS 1.3 facility protocol and facility level settings are incompatible; only one is set and level takes priority.
questions: Can I set both facility protocol and level for VyOS 1.3 logging in Ansible?

answer_card.title: vyos 1.3 logging facility limitation
answer_card.answer_md: For VyOS 1.3, facility protocol and facility level are not compatible in `vyos.vyos`. Only one is set, and **level takes priority**.
